note: Focused on English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese providers; unknown language metadata is kept for manual review. Torrentio is excluded because Limitless is intended to remain HTTPS/direct-stream focused when P2P is disabled. AnikotoTV is pinned to the Asura Synthesis implementation because it reports stream variants directly as SUB/DUB without the mixed English/Japanese labels seen in the All-in-One copy. Cineby is pinned to the Limitless Native Ports implementation for source-matched subtitle support. AniZone and AnimeKai use their upstream lookup engines until subtitle-only patches can be applied without changing episode discovery.
